H2490: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H1637: a threshing-floor (as made even); by analogy, any open area
H2983: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
H2320: the new moon; by implication, a month
H8145: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)
H3245: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H520: properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)
H4060: properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured)
H7223: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun)
H197: a vestibule (as bound to the building)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H3967: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H2889: pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense)
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H2645: to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H1265: a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood)
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H8597: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
H6982: a rafter (forming trenches as it were); by implication, a roof
H5592: a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine)
H7023: a wall (as built in a trench)
H1817: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H3603: a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin)
H8337: six (as an overplus beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth
H4548: a peg (as bristling from the surface)
H8255: probably a weight; used as a commercial standard
H5944: something lofty, i.e. a stair-way; also a second-story room (or even one on the roof); figuratively, the sky
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3671: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H5060: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
H312: properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H8504: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
H713: purple (the color or the dyed stuff)
H5982: a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H1687: the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H7416: a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3199: Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar
H8040: properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand
H1162: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple
